name: jumpgate_terran

children.role: anim_add (idle loop; LAST child, so it is also attached to the LOD meshes)

children.note: NOT attached at build: PlayerJumpgate::addJumpAnimationHandle stores it; PlayerJumpgate::activate removes the idle anim_add child from the current (LOD) root, adds this one and SetAnimationState(1,0)

related.farImpostor: PlayerStaticFar::update: if dist to camera >= 295001 the object is placed at 295000 along the view ray and scaled by 295000/dist

notes: Only the Vossk gate calls setLodChildMeshes (per-LOD emissives 15024/15025). Other races lose the emissive at LOD 1/2 and keep only anim_add. Vossk main/LOD meshes are *_anim (animated). AEGeometry LOD rule (setLodMeshes/updateLod): distances stored squared; LOD k is used when dist^2 > q*lodDist[k]^2 (q = 1.0 / 0.75 / 0.5 for detail setting >0.66 / >0.33 / else). At a LOD only the LAST child added before setLodMeshes (AEGeometry+0x14) plus setLodChildMeshes/setLodChildTransform children stay attached; all other base children disappear.
